descriptions.zh:
调用该接口前，需要在POM文件添加以下依赖：

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
    <artifactId>aliyun-java-sdk-schedulerx2</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.4</version>
</dependency>
```
descriptions.en:
Before you call this API, add the following dependency to your POM file:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
    <artifactId>aliyun-java-sdk-schedulerx2</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.4</version>
</dependency>
```

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 batch-delete-jobs --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source Schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id-list 99341 --region cn-hangzhou
